title: MiJu's Wooly Cows
description: Just a small Pack that makes the cold cow variant look like the Wooly cow from minecraft dungeons and earth
body:
Just a small Pack that makes the cold cow variant look like the Wooly cow from minecraft dungeons and earth

-This version uses the real dungeons texture ( from the minecraft wiki ) just slightly edited to fit the new model

-Java 1.21.5
